blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Shabu worth P496.41 million concealed inside industrial machinery from Mexico was seized by the Bureau of Customs (BOC), the agency said on Monday. According to the BOC, the 73-kilogram shipment arrived in the country on Sept. 26 and was immediately flagged over the suspected presence of illegal drugs. An alert order was issued for its inspection at a warehouse in Pasay City on Oct. 2. The BOC said the shipment underwent X-ray scanning, while a sweep by a K9 unit detected suspicious images.
